id: title:Radu-Raicea:run online evaluations independently of property rules

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a parameterized bypass of property access control for AI evaluation queries, potentially allowing unauthenticated or restricted users to execute HogQL queries without team-specific property restrictions.
review.reason: The chunk introduces a new optional parameter `bypass_property_access_control` to the trace fetching and evaluation workflow, propagating this flag through the query execution chain. This could allow HogQL evaluation queries to proceed without property access restrictions when no authenticated user is present, potentially changing evaluation results and bypassing intended access.
